**Version / Windows / display scale**

You can copy blank prompts and the app version from Help → Report a problem. All reports here are public. Enter build/commit and Windows/display information manually if useful.

**Steps using a disposable fictional database**

**Expected behavior and observed behavior**

**Save, sync, timeout or recovery context (if relevant)**

Use a disposable fictional database. Never attach a real vault, password, key/account-protection file, draft, version backup, plaintext export or screenshot of actual data. Remove personal paths, account/entry/group names and vault URLs. Raw logs or exception text may contain sensitive information too. A blank template does not sanitize text you add.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through https://github.com/w3medialabs/keepasshq/security/advisories/new; see SECURITY.md for the fallback if unavailable. Private reporting is not a place to upload real vaults or factors either.
